notes: UCSD General Catalog major code VA26. All major courses must be taken for a letter grade; only grades of C- or better count. Minimum two-thirds of coursework must be at UCSD. Total: 7 lower-division + 12 upper-division courses. Area A/B/C are chronological art-history distribution groups (Ancient-1800 / 1800-1945 / 1945-Present); 2 courses required from each. Some catalog listings use ranges (e.g. 155-158D) captured as range strings. VERIFIED against catalog requirements page; structure and course lists confirmed. Correction: Area B had VIS 126G (does not exist in catalog - removed) and VIS 126H (Pacific Coast American Indian Art, not the 1800-1945 course listed on the page - corrected to VIS 126HN, which the requirements page lists in Area B).

buckets.label: Required lower-division survey/methods
buckets.note: VIS 22 or 22R (Formations of Modern Art, counts as one) AND VIS 23 (Seminar in Art History Methods).

buckets.label: Intermediate Area B (1800-1945)
buckets.note: Choose 2 from Area B (1800-1945). Corrected: removed VIS 126G (not in catalog); VIS 126H changed to VIS 126HN per requirements-page Area B listing.

buckets.label: Intermediate Area C (1945-Present)
buckets.note: Choose 2 from Area C (1945-Present). VIS 155-158D is a catalog range covering the 155-158 media-studies sequence (155, 156, 157, 157D, 158A-D).

buckets.label: Advanced: Seminar courses
buckets.note: Choose 3 seminars (unused theory-course options may also count).

buckets.label: Advanced: Elective
buckets.note: Any intermediate or advanced art-history course (VIS 120-159 range), or VIS 196 (both quarters = one), VIS 199, or AIP 197. Six intermediate courses must be taken at UCSD.
